body_lead: HYDERABAD: IT Minister D Sridhar Babu on Saturday inaugurated eAppSys’s newly expanded Global Innovation Centre in Hyderabad. He also announced plans to set up an AI university to offer online and offline courses for students and professionals. Speaking at the inauguration, Sridhar Babu urged companies to strive for unicorn status. He noted that while there were only three private startups valued at $1 billion or more earlier, Hyderabad now has 30 to 40.
